d: Welcome home dada janhae 😝  #janhae #jinjingyu #jwnjingjing #GMMTVNEXT viryara #mybeautifulenemy About the show  My Beautiful Enemy (ที่ร้ายที่รัก) is an upcoming 2027 Thai Girls' Love (GL) romantic drama starring the popular pairing JanJing Jing - Jan Ployshompoo @janhae and Jing Jing Prariyapit @jingjingyu36 . The series is a GMMTV production and is based on the novel For Her by KWONAE. It follows Sdavi, a talented perfume creator, and Yara, a socialite who publicly criticizes her fragrance. Their disagreement turns into a fierce rivalry, affecting their reputations and business relationships. As a condition for making amends, Yara is forced to become Sdavi's personal assistant for three months. As they spend more time together, their hostility slowly turns into an unexpected attraction. Blending enemies-to-lovers romance, workplace tension, rivalry, and complicated feelings, the series explores how two women who couldn't stand each other might end up falling in love. d: ПоконгиПоконг — настоящий кумир индонезийского хоррор-фольклора. Если обычные привидения тратят кучу сил на стоны, летание и вой, то поконг возвёл минимализм и харизму в абсолют. Почему быть поконгом — это чистый кайф: Никакой суеты с гардеробом. Забудь про муки выбора одежды по утрам. Твой аутфит — это стильный, белоснежный саван (каин кафан), завязанный узелками над головой, на шее и у ног. Мода меняется, а классика остаётся навсегда. Идеальная тренировка ног. Так как руки и ноги крепко запеленгованы, единственный способ перемещаться — прыжки. Ты по умолчанию становишься легендой плиометрики и обладателем самых мощных икр в потустороннем мире. Эффектное появление. Ты не размениваешься на банальные шорохи. Твоё приближение — это ритмичное, жутковатое пог-пог-пог по земле. А когда ты замираешь в темноте под пальмой с открытым бледным лицом и тёмными кругами под глазами — все голливудские актеры нервно курят в стороне. Абсолютный чилл. По преданию, поконг появляется только потому, что кто-то забыл развязать узелки на саване перед похоронами. То есть твоё существование — это буквально официальный протест против незавершённых дел. Ты просто ходишь (прыгаешь) и напоминаешь живым об их ошибках. Звезда поп-культуры. В Индонезии и Малайзии ты не просто дух, ты главный герой сотен хоррор-фильмов, комедий и мобильных игр. Тебя знают все — от мала до велика. Никакой сложной магии: только белая ткань, прыгучесть и умение эффектно стоять в углу.

d: 🎬 Munkar – Fear Rooted in Faith and Consequences Munkar is an Indonesian horror film that blends supernatural elements with themes of faith, guilt, and moral consequences. Set in a strict religious boarding school, the story follows a troubled student whose behavior begins to raise concern among teachers and classmates. After a disturbing incident, the atmosphere in the school changes. Strange and unsettling events start to occur, creating fear and confusion among everyone. It soon becomes clear that something beyond normal understanding is at play—something connected to past actions and hidden truths. The film builds tension through its eerie setting and emotional depth rather than relying only on sudden scares. It explores how fear can grow from within, especially when secrets refuse to stay buried. Munkar is not just a horror story—it’s a haunting reflection on choices, belief, and the consequences that follow #fypシ #fyp #movie #tiktok

d: People who could have change the world but disappeared 😳 #Interesting #History #fyp #mystery #space  - In this video, we explore the stories of extraordinary people who appeared to have incredible potential but later disappeared from the spotlight. From mysterious individuals with unusual abilities to people whose stories left more questions than answers, these cases have fascinated the world for years. One of the strangest examples is Boriska Kipriyanovich, a Russian boy who claimed he had lived on Mars in a previous life. According to reports, he began speaking about space and other planets when he was very young, and by around seven years old, he was telling people detailed stories about an alleged Martian civilisation destroyed by a catastrophe. He claimed he had been a pilot on Mars before being reborn on Earth. As he grew older, he largely disappeared from public attention, leaving people curious about what happened to the so-called “Boy from Mars.” However, his extraordinary claims have never been scientifically verified. If you love mysterious people, unexplained stories, extraordinary childhood claims and fascinating cases that seem to defy explanation, this video is for you. From people who vanished from the public eye to individuals whose unusual stories continue to spark debate, these cases reveal how some mysteries can remain unanswered for years.

d: Not all ghosts rest after death, especially the ones who die in terror. In Thailand, the Phi Tai Hong is one of the most feared spirits. These ghosts come from people who died suddenly or violently. Their rage is raw. Their souls never settle. Locals believe the Phi Tai Hong haunt the places they died, screaming through the night, attacking anyone who gets too close. Some say their faces twist in agony. Others say they appear calm until it’s too late. If you feel the air go still near a crash site or riverbank, walk away. #horrortok #Thailand  #GhostStories #HorrorCommunity #CreepyCurrent

d: 👻 ผีนางรำ เป็นหนึ่งในตำนานผีไทยที่โด่งดังและเป็นที่รู้จักกันดีครับ โดยทั่วไปแล้ว "ผีนางรำ" จะมีความเชื่อที่เกี่ยวข้องกับ:** รูปลักษณ์: มักปรากฏกายในชุดไทยหรือชุดประจำถิ่นของนาฏศิลป์ไทย แต่งหน้าทาปาก และสวมชฎาบนศีรษะ สถานที่ปรากฏ: มักเกี่ยวข้องกับสถานที่ที่เคยใช้ในการฝึกซ้อมหรือแสดงนาฏศิลป์ เช่น ห้องนาฏศิลป์ หรือบริเวณที่มีการรำถวายสิ่งศักดิ์สิทธิ์ เสียงดนตรี: ที่ใดมีผีนางรำ ที่นั่นมักมีเสียงดนตรีไทยบรรเลงคลอมาด้วย ที่มาของตำนาน: เล่ากันว่าอาจเป็นวิญญาณของอดีตนางรำที่เสียชีวิตอย่างไม่สงบ เช่น ถูกฆาตกรรม หรือเสียชีวิตเพราะทำผิดต่อครูบาอาจารย์ (ไม่รักดี ดูถูกครู) หรือมีความอาถรรพ์ผูกพันอยู่กับสถานที่นั้น ๆ ลักษณะความเชื่อเพิ่มเติม: การปรากฏตัว: บางตำนานเล่าว่าผีนางรำจะปรากฏตัวเพื่อหลอกหลอน หรือบางครั้งก็เข้าฝัน การช่วยผู้คน: อีกด้านหนึ่งก็มีความเชื่อว่าผีนางรำบางตนอาจเมตตาผู้ที่เคารพบูชาพ่อแก่แม่แก่ หรือพระพิราพ ซึ่งถือเป็นครูในวงการนาฏศิลป์ และอาจมาช่วยมอบทักษะในการรำให้แก่ผู้ที่ศรัทธา เรื่องราวของผีนางรำถูกนำมาเล่าและสร้างเป็นสื่อต่าง ๆ มากมาย ทั้งเรื่องเล่า ภาพยนตร์ และละคร เพราะเป็นตำนานที่มีความน่ากลัวและมีเสน่ห์ตามแบบฉบับความเชื่อของไทยครับ #ผีนางรำ #วันฮาโลวีน  #คลิปนี้ขึ้นฟีด  #ขึ้นฟีดเถอะ

d: Reyna Manalo observed a creature from her window at approximately 10 PM, in the Pampanga Province in the Philippines. Regional documentation  identifies the creature as an Aswang — a shape-shifting entity. Reyna stated, “It was as if it was looking right into my soul with those yellow beady eyes.” The creature was standing upright outside her window and appeared to be gesturing for her to come outside. Reyna applied a traditional coconut oil preparation reported in regional documentation to have protective properties against Aswang contact. The beast retreated shortly after the oil was administered. #aswang #philippines #folklore #cryptid #paranormal

d: In Filipino folklore, the Tiktik is a terrifying creature associated with the aswang—said to roam at night searching for pregnant women. Its eerie “tik-tik” call plays a cruel trick: when it sounds loud, it may still be far away… but when the sound grows faint, legend says it’s already dangerously close. And when Manuel realizes what has come for his family, he turns to an old protection passed down through generations—the buntot ng pagi. But did he really drive it away? 🌑 Once Upon Pinas 🇵🇭 | Filipino Folklore #OnceUponPinas #Tiktik #FilipinoFolklore #PhilippineMythology #Aswang

d: Save the cat at all costs 🐱 🎥 A Quiet Place: Day One (2024) A Quiet Place: Day One is a 2024 American apocalyptic horror film, written and directed by Michael Sarnoski, based on a story he conceived with John Krasinski. It is the third installment in the A Quiet Place film series, and a prequel spinoff of the first film. Day One stars Lupita Nyong'o as a terminally ill woman during the early stages of an invasion in New York City by blind extraterrestrial creatures with an acute sense of hearing. The supporting cast includes Joseph Quinn and Djimon Hounsou, who reprises his role from A Quiet Place Part II. Development on A Quiet Place: Day One began in November 2020, with Jeff Nichols set to write and direct. Despite a completed script, Nichols dropped out of the film in October 2021. In January 2022, Sarnoski was announced to replace Nichols as writer and director; he was approached by Krasinski because of his feature directorial debut Pig (2021). Principal photography took place from February 2023 to April 2023 in London, England. A Quiet Place: Day One premiered at the Tribeca Festival on June 26, 2024, and was released in the United States by Paramount Pictures on June 28. The film received generally positive reviews from critics and grossed $262 million worldwide on a $67 million production budget. Plot Sam, a terminally ill cancer patient, lives at a hospice outside New York City with her cat, Frodo. Reuben, a nurse, convinces a reluctant Sam to join a group outing to a marionette show in Manhattan. While in the city, the group notices meteor-like objects falling from the sky. Shortly afterwards, alien creatures attack the gathered crowd and passersby. One creature hits a noisy ambulance, and the explosion knocks Sam unconscious. Sam later wakes up inside the puppet theater with Frodo, Reuben, and other survivors, including Henri, who signals her to remain quiet. Announcements from US military helicopters warn civilians to stay silent and hidden until the authorities can rescue them. Sam then witnesses fighter jets bombing and destroying the bridges leading out of Manhattan, preventing the creatures from leaving the island. d: Membalas @Mellllliii__ Misteri Bayi yang Ditinggalkan di Teras Rumah Warga Seluma Mulai Terungkap SELUMA – Misteri penemuan bayi laki-laki yang ditinggalkan di teras rumah warga Desa Karang Anyar, Kecamatan Semidang Alas Maras (SAM), Kabupaten Seluma, mulai menemukan titik terang. Satreskrim Polres Seluma dikabarkan telah mengantongi sejumlah petunjuk yang diduga dapat mengungkap identitas orang tua kandung bayi tersebut. Salah satu petunjuk penting berasal dari penelusuran bukti fisik bayi, khususnya cap telapak kaki atau footprint. Berdasarkan informasi yang dihimpun, pencocokan data medis tersebut mengarah pada rekam jejak persalinan di RSUD Hasanuddin Damrah Manna, Kabupaten Bengkulu Selatan. Temuan ini menjadi salah satu titik penting dalam penyelidikan. Melalui penelusuran rekam medis tersebut, penyidik berupaya memastikan asal-usul bayi sekaligus mengidentifikasi pihak yang diduga berkaitan dengan peristiwa penelantaran tersebut. Di tengah penyelidikan, informasi mengenai latar belakang keluarga yang diduga merupakan orang tua biologis bayi juga mulai mencuat. Keduanya disebut-sebut masih berstatus sebagai pelajar. Namun, informasi tersebut masih perlu dipastikan melalui proses penyelidikan dan keterangan resmi kepolisian. Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, persoalan keluarga diduga menjadi salah satu latar belakang peristiwa memilukan ini. Nenek dari bayi tersebut disebut-sebut tidak menerima kehadiran sang cucu karena diduga lahir di luar ikatan pernikahan yang sah. Bahkan, ayah biologis bayi dikabarkan memiliki keinginan untuk bertanggung jawab dan menikahi ibu dari anak tersebut. Namun, niat itu diduga menghadapi kendala setelah muncul permintaan uang mahar sebesar Rp20 juta dari pihak keluarga ibu bayi. Ketidaksanggupan memenuhi permintaan tersebut serta dugaan penolakan keluarga disebut-sebut memperkeruh persoalan pasangan muda itu. Situasi tersebut diduga menjadi salah satu faktor yang melatarbelakangi keputusan meninggalkan bayi di teras rumah warga, lengkap dengan sejumlah perlengkapan dan sepucuk surat berisi permohonan agar bayi dirawat dengan baik. Sementara itu, bayi laki-laki tersebut saat ini masih mendapatkan perawatan di RSUD Tais. Meski sejumlah petunjuk mulai terungkap, identitas orang tua kandung serta motif sebenarnya di balik peristiwa tersebut masih menunggu kepastian hasil penyelidikan Polres Seluma. Semua dugaan terkait pihak keluarga tetap harus dibuktikan melalui proses hukum dan keterangan resmi kepolisian. #BayiSeluma #PenemuanBayi #PolresSeluma #BeritaBengkulu #Seluma

d: 🐾 Singapura Cats 🐾 The Singapura is one of the smallest cat breeds in the world, but full of personality. They have a beautiful ticked tabby coat, giving them a warm, glowing look with no stripes or spots on the body. You’ll also notice: ✨ Huge eyes (usually green or hazel) ✨ Large ears for their size ✨ A delicate, compact body ✨ A soft sepia-toned coat Singapuras are known for being playful, affectionate, and very curious. They love attention and tend to stay kitten-like in personality. If you see a tiny cat with big eyes and a smooth, ticked coat, it’s likely a Singapura. #Singapura #CatBreeds #TickedTabby #CatFacts #CatsOfPinterest

d: Blue came to us at 5 months old from the streets of Singapore. You could take the boy off the street, but you could never take the street out of the boy.  Almost every day he would dig his way out of our garden and go scavenging, spreading bin bags across pavements and sometimes bringing them back home to share. He got away with it for years until the law finally caught up with him.  Blue then moved to the UK to live out his final years meeting dogs on Wandsworth Common with his polite and gentlemanly air. It is true to say that he has left a gentle paw print on our hearts.  Thank you to @thelondonvet for their kindness to Blue and for making his last moments so peaceful. #singaporestreetdog

d: [VOLUNTEERS NEEDED] There are still quite a lot of abandoned and stray dogs and cats in Singapore, especially around the industrial areas, and there’s a whole community of independent feeders who have dedicated their time and effort for years to make sure these animals don’t starve. Last Saturday night, I joined Tails of the Streets (@tots.sg) on their weekly feeding and we covered the Kranji and Sungei Kadut industrial areas. The factories have closed down and moved away, resulting in these dogs being abandoned and nobody to care for them.  They can’t all be put in the shelters because there are too many of them and limited space in the shelters so what we can do is to adopt from shelters to free up space. Most of the dogs we saw were skittish and timid, except for a friendly few, and I wish I can take them home to care for them. If I become rich enough one day I want to buy a landed property just for these homeless animals! Tails of the Streets need your help! They need people who can drive and have a car to help with the distribution of food along the routes - the more cars, the faster the process takes. More essentially, they need food donors - people who can donate the ingredients AND cook. All kinds of meat, rice, eggs and vegetables - volunteers spend hours cooking 5-20kg of food and sometimes when manpower falls short, they don’t have enough food. They don’t take monetary contributions or dry food as they have no space for storage. You can reach out to them directly via DM on Instagram if you’d like to help!
zh: 新加坡Tails of the Streets组织需司机和烹饪志愿者救助工业区流浪动物。

Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. Dalam video yang beredar, anak-anak tampak berulang kali mengulang gerakan demi mencapai ketepatan. Latihan intens itu menggambarkan proses panjang di balik keindahan tari Bali yang selama ini terlihat memukau di atas panggung. #BALI #videoviral #tari

d: An outstanding performance of the Magunatip bamboo dance by Budayawan, one of Sabah’s best traditional dance groups. Magunatip, the traditional dance of the Murut, who were once the headhunting warriors of Borneo, demands both bravery and agility. Dancers must skillfully time their movements between clapping bamboo poles to avoid getting their feet trapped or struck. It’s almost unbelievable that this dancer can perform the fast-paced bamboo dance blindfolded for nearly a minute. You can also catch Budayawan showcasing their incredible skills at Imago Shopping Mall. #sabah #malaysia #borneo #murut #bamboodance #magunatip #traditionaldance
